warning: Existing macOS continue-on-error makes run success despite one failed macOS job; inspect every job.
failure: Timer-based late response resolved during bounded cleanup under delayed scheduling, so there was no undecided response at return.
controlledReproduction: Original 150ms response/30ms budget retains the note normally. Blocking the parent 200ms inside fetch creates the hosted empty-note failure shape while the response is canceled and files remain absent. Production unchanged; does not prove that exact stall duration occurred on hosted runner.
probeCaveat: The first probe snapshots body.locked immediately on its cancellation hook; the owner may not have completed releaseLock yet. The repaired test must observe release, not equate cancel-hook entry with completion.
